title: Question Item
description: One verified item in the offline item bank (v0: NEET Biology, English/Hindi, text-only).

question_text.description: The full question as a student would see it.

options.description: Answer options, only present for MCQ items. Omit entirely for free-response items.

answer_text.description: The verified, fully explained answer — what gets read back to the student.

concept_tag.description: Top-level concept, e.g. 'Cell Biology', 'Genetics and Evolution'.

subconcept_tag.description: Narrower topic within the concept, e.g. 'Cell Organelles'.

misconception_tags.description: Maps each wrong option's id to a misconception taxonomy tag. Empty object for non-MCQ items.

source.description: Where this item came from, e.g. 'NCERT Class 11 Biology, Ch 8' or a PYQ citation.

verified_by.description: Reviewer identifier or process that verified this item (v0: seeded internally, no review pipeline yet).

exam_tier.description: Only NEET is in scope for v0. JEE Main/Advanced come later per docs/PRD.md phased scope.

language.description: v0 is text-only English/Hindi. Hinglish and voice come in v1.
